harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-22, before any result of this build was read (borg-zoo#636; borg-reborn-rs #867, PR #868). Five arms on one build,
classes-18 at 300,000 turns, 18 starts per arm (90 cells), evidence retained. Gate: no config_error; one binary; each arm's values
in params-core.json; every game ends in death or at the cap; stalls apart. Pairs: confused against ctl, confused-clw against
ctl-clw, confused-pb against ctl and against confused (the second control, ctl-clw, is a profile of the same experiment; the
pairing is made in the report). Primary measures, fixed here: (1) per class, the confused attacks made by direction ("# Confused:
aiming by direction N" notes), by kind (throw, missile, wand, rod) and against melee while confused; (2) the cure holds
("attacking first (#867)" notes) and the turns spent confused next to an immobile confuser; (3) deaths while confused or within 20
turns of confusion, with rescued and newly killed pairs; (4) all deaths with rescued and newly killed pairs; (5) mean max CL and
depth, and alive at the cap. Directional only; a claim needs a fresh seed block (RULES 14). The point-blank part is decided from
confused-pb; the owner ships only attack_confused_by_direction 1 (PR #904).
